==English==

===Etymology===
From {{der|en|fr|exister}}, from {{der|en|la|exsisto|existō, exsistō|I am, I exist, appear, arise}}, from {{m|la|ex||out}} + {{m|la|sisto|sistere|to set, place}} (related to {{m|la|stō|stare|to stand, to be stood}}), ultimately from {{der|en|ine-pro|*stísteh₂ti}}, from the root {{m|ine-pro|*steh₂-||stand}}; see {{m|en|stand}}. Compare {{m|en|assist}}, {{m|en|consist}}, {{m|en|desist}}, {{m|en|insist}}, {{m|en|persist}}, {{m|en|resist}}. Cognate with {{cog|es|existir}}, {{cog|fr|exister}}, {{cog|it|esistere}}, {{cog|de|existieren}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ɪɡˈzɪst/|[ɪɡˈzɪst]|a=non-weak vowel}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-exist.ogg|a=GA}}
* {{IPA|en|/əɡˈzɪst/|[əɡˈzɪst]|a=weak vowel}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɪst|s=2}}
* {{hyph|en|ex|ist}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|intransitive|stative}} to [[be]]; have [[existence]]; have being or [[reality]]
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2012|author=The Unicode Consortium|title=The Unicode Standard: Version 6.1 – Core Specification|isbn=978-1-936213-02-3|page=12
|passage=Various relationships may '''exist''' between character and glyph: {{...}}}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2012|author=The Unicode Consortium|title=The Unicode Standard: Version 6.1 – Core Specification|isbn=978-1-936213-02-3|page=19
|passage={{...}}, regardless of whether those characters also '''existed''' in other character encoding standards.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2012|author=The Unicode Consortium|title=The Unicode Standard: Version 6.1 – Core Specification|isbn=978-1-936213-02-3|page=55
|passage={{...}}, which will be treated either as an update of the '''existing''' character encoding or as a completely new character encoding.}}
